Sect: Independent

The Gangrel are wanderers and survivalists who shun fixed territory and city politics, preferring the wilderness and the company of animals to courtly intrigue. Hardy and self-reliant, they once held a seat on the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}'s Inner Council but abandoned the sect entirely after a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} assault, choosing independence over allegiance.

Disciplines: Animalism, Fortitude, Protean

Advantage: All Gangrel gain a free level of Ability in each of Animal Ken and Survival.

Disadvantage: Each time a Gangrel frenzies she gains a new Negative Social Trait of Bestial, Feral or Repugnant — a lasting animalistic mark. These can never be bought off or removed without magical assistance (such as Vicissitude or Obfuscate). No more than five Negative Traits can be gained this way.

Organization: Solitary by nature, Gangrel rarely form lasting hierarchies; City Gangrel who remain in urban environments are a notable variant of the clan's broader outlander culture.
